name: tasveg-5-0-xref-iucn-get-90m-best-candidate
title: Cross-referencing Tasmanian vegetation map (TASVEG 5.0) to the IUCN Global Ecosystem Typology: 90m Best-Candidate Spatial Synthesis
description: Spatial synthesis (90 m GeoTIFF rasters) and tabular lookup tables cross-referencing TASVEG 5.0 vegetation communities of Tasmania to Level 3 Ecosystem Functional Groups (EFGs) of the IUCN Global Ecosystem Typology based on Round 2 structured expert elicitation across five interpreters.

resources.name: tasveg-xref-best-candidate
resources.description: Synthesised best-candidate cross-reference table linking all 156 TASVEG 5.0 statewide mapping units (153 eligible vegetation communities and 3 non-eligible natural units) to IUCN GET Level 3 Ecosystem Functional Groups from Round 2 expert elicitation.

fields.name: VEG_GROUP
fields.description: Broad TASVEG 5.0 vegetation group name.

fields.name: VEGCODE
fields.description: Three-letter TASVEG 5.0 mapping unit code.

fields.name: VEGCODE_D
fields.description: Full description of the TASVEG 5.0 vegetation community or mapping unit.

fields.name: eligible
fields.description: Whether the TASVEG 5.0 mapping unit is conceptually eligible for cross-referencing to a single ecosystem concept in IUCN GET (FALSE for OAQ, ORO, OSM).

fields.name: EFG
fields.description: Best-candidate IUCN Global Ecosystem Typology Level 3 Ecosystem Functional Group code (e.g., T2.5).

fields.name: efg_name
fields.description: Full name of the best-candidate IUCN GET Ecosystem Functional Group.

fields.name: efg_pixel_value
fields.description: Standard integer pixel value used in TASVEG-xref-target.tiff and the Global Ecosystems Atlas (geco package).

fields.name: efg_hex_code
fields.description: Standard hexadecimal color code (#RRGGBB) for the EFG from the geco package.

fields.name: efg_rgb_code
fields.description: Comma-separated RGB color values (R,G,B) for the EFG.

fields.name: round
fields.description: Expert elicitation round number used for synthesis (2 = revised assessment after group discussion).

fields.name: prop_memb
fields.description: Proportion of total Round 2 membership votes across all interpreters assigned to the best-candidate EFG (0 to 1).

fields.name: total_memb
fields.description: Sum of membership values across all interpreters for the source VEGCODE in Round 2 (equals 5 when all 5 interpreters assessed the unit with weights summing to 1).

fields.name: supporting
fields.description: Number of interpreters in Round 2 who assigned a non-zero membership (> 0) to the best-candidate EFG (range: 2 to 5).

fields.name: total_interp
fields.description: Total number of interpreters who assessed the source VEGCODE in Round 2 (5).

resources.name: iucn-get-pixel-lookup
resources.description: Lookup table for the 21 IUCN Global Ecosystem Typology Level 3 Ecosystem Functional Groups mapped as best candidates in Tasmania, including integer raster pixel values, realm/biome hierarchy, and color codes.

fields.name: efg_pixel_value
fields.description: Integer pixel value encoded in TASVEG-xref-target.tiff (9 to 170).

fields.name: EFG
fields.description: IUCN GET Level 3 Ecosystem Functional Group code (e.g., T2.3, TF1.6).

fields.name: efg_name
fields.description: Full name of the Ecosystem Functional Group.

fields.name: realm_id
fields.description: IUCN GET Level 1 Realm code (T, TF, F, MT, MFT).

fields.name: realm_name
fields.description: IUCN GET Level 1 Realm name.

fields.name: biome_id
fields.description: IUCN GET Level 2 Functional Biome code.

fields.name: biome_name
fields.description: IUCN GET Level 2 Functional Biome name.

fields.name: efg_hex_code
fields.description: Standard hexadecimal color code (#RRGGBB).

fields.name: efg_rgb_code
fields.description: Comma-separated RGB color components (R,G,B).

fields.name: n_tasveg_units
fields.description: Number of TASVEG 5.0 mapping units assigned to this EFG as their best candidate.

resources.name: tasveg-xref-target
resources.description: 90 m raster of the best-candidate IUCN GET Ecosystem Functional Group (integer pixel values 9 to 170 matching IUCN-GET-pixel-lookup.csv, with embedded color table) in EPSG:28355.

resources.name: tasveg-xref-membership
resources.description: 90 m floating-point raster of the proportion of total membership votes (prop_memb, range 0.33 to 1.00) supporting the best-candidate EFG in EPSG:28355.

resources.name: tasveg-xref-supporting
resources.description: 90 m raster of the number of interpreters (supporting, range 2 to 5 out of 5) assigning non-zero membership to the best-candidate EFG in EPSG:28355.

resources.name: tasveg-xref-target-qml
resources.description: QGIS layer style file providing automatic paletted rendering and EFG code/name legend labels for TASVEG-xref-target.tiff.

resources.name: tasveg-xref-target-clr
resources.description: GDAL / ArcGIS RGBA color map file for TASVEG-xref-target.tiff.
